verdict_reason: NOTIFICATION_EDITED always skips versionId, including after submission, and that path is untested in the VersionId suite.

todos.issue: NO_VERSION_ID_EVENTS always omits versionId for NOTIFICATION_EDITED, including AMEND-phase saves after a submission, so the firehose snapshot can drop the current version; VersionId tests never cover EDITED.
todos.fix: Omit versionId only when submissionCount is 0 (keep CREATED/DELETED as always-absent); carry the current count on post-submit EDITED; add VersionId tests for draft edit (absent) and AMEND edit (carry-forward).
